rewrites.comment: Client-side routes that are NOT prerendered — /blog/:slug for posts added after build, and anything unmatched, which renders the in-app 404. Prerendered paths resolve to their own dist/<path>/index.html before reaching this rule.

headers.comment: Hashed build assets are immutable; the HTML shells must never be cached hard or a deploy won't reach returning visitors.

Images are NOT content-hashed — pnpm images rewrites the same filenames. `immutable` here would mean replacing a photo leaves returning visitors on the old one for up to a year, with no way to purge their browser cache. A day of freshness with a long stale-while-revalidate keeps it fast on the CDN while staying correctable.
